title: Stealth fighter panels rumored to be anti-gravity

tellings.quote: people go in and pull panels out of it and put them in briefcases and go away. And he said the rumor was that some of those were anti-gravity just to help it fly in a different way

plain: People would come to a US Air Force stealth fighter, pull panels out of it, put them in briefcases and leave, and the rumor was that some of those panels were anti-gravity devices that helped the plane fly in an unusual way. The author Greg Bishop passes this on from a man who told it to him. If true, it would mean anti-gravity technology was hidden inside a known military aircraft.
